newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Jan retail sales value rises 2.2 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Irish Jan retail sales value rises 2.2 pct m/m.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales rose a provisional 2.2 percent in January, giving a year-on-year rise of 7.4 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Thursday.

In December, the value of sales fell a final 1.0 percent for a year-on-year rise of 7.8 percent. This was revised from provisional estimates of a 0.9 percent fall on the month and a 7.9 percent increase year-on-year.

Sales volume in December was down 1.1 percent on November and was 5.6 percent higher than December last year.
